name: book-translator-hub
description: Book Translator Hub is the universal, zero-wait bilingual reading overlay and real-time translation engine for Calibre-Web Automated (CWA), Kavita, and self-hosted ebook libraries. Powered by local LLMs (vLLM, Ollama, Bifrost) or leading cloud providers (Gemini, OpenAI, Claude, DeepSeek, Groq). Features literary-tuned chunking, instant SSE token streaming, context-aware translation, auto-detect source language, and SQLite WAL persistent caching.

paths.name: Appdata (Database & Cache)
paths.description: Persistent storage for SQLite translations.db and persistent caching. Requires container appuser ownership (UID 101:GID 102, e.g. chown -R 101:102 /mnt/user/appdata/book-translator-hub/data; chmod 0700).

ports.name: API Port
ports.description: Direct translation API port (REST + SSE streaming)

ports.name: Proxy Port
ports.description: Reader proxy injection port (browse CWA or Kavita through this port to get the translation overlay)

variables.name: Runtime Role
variables.description: Runtime role: all (combined API + proxy overlay on :8385 - recommended for Unraid), api (pure API mode for SWAG/master proxy), proxy (reverse proxy overlay), hub (multi-reader)

variables.name: Calibre-Web (CWA) URL
variables.description: URL of your Calibre-Web / CWA container (e.g. http://192.168.0.122:8383 or http://calibre-web-automated:8083)

variables.name: Kavita URL
variables.description: URL of your Kavita container (e.g. http://192.168.0.122:5547 or http://kavita:5000)

variables.name: LLM Provider
variables.description: LLM backend provider: local (vLLM / Ollama / Bifrost), gemini, openai, anthropic, groq, deepseek, openrouter

variables.name: LLM Model
variables.description: Model name (e.g. gemma4-12b, qwen2.5-14b, deepseek-chat, gpt-4o-mini)

variables.name: Local LLM URL
variables.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint of your local LLM (vLLM/Ollama/Bifrost). Use host IP or host.docker.internal, NOT localhost.

variables.name: LLM API Key
variables.description: API key for cloud providers (leave blank when using local LLM)

variables.name: Allowed Origins
variables.description: Comma-separated allowed web origins for CORS (e.g. https://books.example.com,https://translate.example.com)

variables.name: Auth Mode
variables.description: Authentication: disabled (for private LAN), token (for reverse proxy), cwa_session, reader_session

variables.name: Allow Insecure Auth
variables.description: Set to true to allow BT_AUTH_MODE=disabled on private LAN

variables.name: Batch Size
variables.description: Paragraphs per LLM call. Higher = faster throughput on GPU models.

variables.name: Batch Source Budget
variables.description: Max input source tokens per batch group. Paragraphs exceeding this are split or processed as singletons.

variables.name: Prefetch Pacing Delay (ms)
variables.description: Delay in milliseconds between background lookahead prefetch requests (0 to disable pacing)

variables.name: Max Tokens (single)
variables.description: Maximum token ceiling for a single paragraph request

variables.name: Max Tokens (batch)
variables.description: Maximum token ceiling for a batched request

variables.name: Max Upstream Inflight
variables.description: Maximum simultaneous requests sent to LLM backend (e.g. 4-8 for GPU, 1-2 for CPU)

variables.name: Max Concurrent
variables.description: Maximum simultaneous batch requests processed by Hub

variables.name: Request Timeout (s)
variables.description: Timeout in seconds before an LLM request is aborted

variables.name: Context Window
variables.description: Surrounding paragraphs given as [CONTEXT] to LLM for literary coherence

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Container timezone
